name: LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures
description: Set between The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi, The Freemaker Adventures centers on a family of three young siblings—young boy Rowan, his sister Kordi, and their brother Zander—known as the Freemakers, who salvage parts from destroyed or damaged ships which they use to build new ones, which they sell in order to make their living. They are accompanied by their salvaged battle droid Roger.

videos.title: Home One
videos.overview: The Freemakers prove their worth to the Rebellion with Kordi's amazing bartering skills.

videos.title: Thrown Into Battle
videos.overview: Roger saves the Rebel fleet from destruction when he accidentally turns himself into a torpedo.

videos.title: Rowan's Secret Adventure
videos.overview: Rowan winds up in a Y-Wing's tail-gunner seat in the middle of an intense battle against the Empire.

videos.title: Zander Freemaker, Superstar Pilot Guy!
videos.overview: Zander attempts to join a fighter squadron by flying his own ship, the Blazemaker.

videos.title: Beware the Gamorrean Flu!
videos.overview: The Freemakers undertake a daring mission to save two of the Rebellion's finest heroes: Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca.

videos.title: A Hero Discovered
videos.overview: Rowan meets a Jedi named Naare and learns of the Kyber Saber...

videos.title: The Mines of Graballa
videos.overview: While attempting to retrieve the Kyber Saber Crystal from an asteroid field, Rowan is captured by Graballa the Hutt

videos.title: Zander's Joyride
videos.overview: When Zander takes a classic starfighter out for a joyride, he winds up in the clutches of Darth Vader...

videos.title: The Lost Treasure of Cloud City
videos.overview: A hunt for precious cargo brings the Freemakers to Cloud City...

videos.title: Peril on Kashyyyk
videos.overview: Kordi's attempts to save money force the Freemakers into trouble on Kashyyyk...

videos.title: Crossing Paths
videos.overview: Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia show the Freemakers the selfless nature of The Force

videos.title: Race on Tatooine
videos.overview: Graballa lures the Freemakers into a trap

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: The Freemakers meet Hondo who gives them a seemingly simple job that turns out to be much harder than they thought

videos.title: The Kyber Saber Chase
videos.overview: The Freemakers are in hot pursuit of the remaining Kyber Saber Crystals, but each time they find one, Naare steals it away

videos.title: The Maker of Zoh
videos.overview: The Freemakers travel to Zoh where they meet the Maker, who teaches Rowan how to build using the Force

videos.title: Showdown on Hoth
videos.overview: The conclusion for the race for the Kyber Saber Crystals looms on the horizon

videos.title: Duel of Destiny
videos.overview: Rowan and Naare enter into a lightsaber duel with unbelievable consequences

videos.title: Return of the Kyber Saber
videos.overview: The exciting battle for the Kyber Saber comes down to Rowan vs Naare vs the Emperor

videos.title: A New Home
videos.overview: New to Home One, the Freemakers embark on a series of misadventures to assist and maybe even impress the rebel fleet.

videos.title: Trouble on Tibalt
videos.overview: While scavenging for the Rebellion, the Freemakers meet the Empire's newest threat, M-OC!

videos.title: The Tower of Alistan Nor
videos.overview: Looking for inspiration, Rowan journeys to Alistan Nor where he finds an abandoned city of Jedi ... and M-OC!

videos.title: The Embersteel Blade
videos.overview: In an attempt to attain parts for the Arrowhead, Kordi goes undercover at a swanky Imperial auction.

videos.title: The Storms of Taul
videos.overview: The Freemakers cross paths again with Hondo and wind up trapped on Taul with M-OC.

videos.title: Return to the Wheel
videos.overview: The Freemakers return to the Wheel to retrieve a special part, but all they find are Graballa the Hutt and his team of bounty hunters.

videos.title: The Lost Crystals of Qalydon
videos.overview: The Freemakers help a village of Lurmen regain their stolen Kyber crystals from the Empire.

videos.title: The Pit and the Pinnacle
videos.overview: Using his unique powers, Rowan leads the Freemakers to a planet rich in Kyber crystals ... and danger.

videos.title: Flight of the Arrowhead
videos.overview: The Freemakers have all the parts they need to complete the Arrowhead, but can they build the ship in time to save the Rebel Fleet?

videos.title: A Perilous Rescue
videos.overview: Yearning for adventure and excitement, Rowan launches himself on a solo mission that brings him face-to-face with M-OC.

videos.title: Escape From Coruscant
videos.overview: Against orders, Kordi and Zander take the Arrowhead to Coruscant in a desperate bid to save their brother.

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: Rowan battles M-OC in the upper atmosphere of Shantipole.

videos.title: Return of the Return of the Jedi
videos.overview: The Freemakers wind up in the middle of the Battle of Endor where Rowan has his final confrontation with M-OC.
